title: Why Lamborghini Built the Revuelto the Way It Did
description:
In May twenty twenty-one, Lamborghini's boss made a promise that sounded impossible. The brand of screaming V12s would electrify its entire lineup, cut the CO2 of its cars in half, and still build the wildest supercars in the world. Two years later, the answer rolled out of Sant'Agata Bolognese. This is why Lamborghini built the Revuelto the way it did. It is a story about a tractor maker who wanted to beat Ferrari, a company that changed owners again and again, a hybrid named after a lightning bolt, and a team of engineers who refused to put a turbocharger on their V12. And every decision they made is hidden somewhere in the shape of this car.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
